source_text: Go to the mansion and make sure my officer is okay.

structure.raw_value: BoAnEx.Go to the mansion and make sure my officer is okay.
structure.script_literal: "BoAnEx.Go to the mansion and make sure my officer is okay."

translation: Jedź do rezydencji i upewnij się, że z moim funkcjonariuszem wszystko w porządku.

source_text: Are all these girls supposed to be here? I’m not a babysitter.

structure.raw_value: BoAnDe.Are all these girls supposed to be here? I’m not a babysitter.
structure.script_literal: "BoAnDe.Are all these girls supposed to be here? I’m not a babysitter."

translation: Czy wszystkie te dziewczyny mają tu być? Nie jestem niańką.

source_text: What a horrible way to spend a weekend. You owe me, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: BoAnDe.What a horrible way to spend a weekend. You owe me, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "BoAnDe.What a horrible way to spend a weekend. You owe me, 1Hero."

translation: Co za okropny sposób na spędzenie weekendu. Jesteś mi winien przysługę, 1Hero.

source_text: Officer Rinaldi was in a hurry to leave. Is everything okay?

structure.raw_value: BrBaDe.Officer Rinaldi was in a hurry to leave. Is everything okay?
structure.script_literal: "BrBaDe.Officer Rinaldi was in a hurry to leave. Is everything okay?"

translation: Funkcjonariusz Rinaldi bardzo się spieszył. Wszystko w porządku?

source_text: The commissioner must feel there’s a bigger threat at the Wilkes mansion, but don’t worry, an officer will be here Monday.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.The commissioner must feel there’s a bigger threat at the Wilkes mansion, but don’t worry, an officer will be here Monday.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.The commissioner must feel there’s a bigger threat at the Wilkes mansion, but don’t worry, an officer will be here Monday."

translation: Komisarz musiała uznać, że w rezydencji Wilkesów czai się większe zagrożenie, ale spokojnie — w poniedziałek przyjedzie tu funkcjonariusz.

source_text: Two nights with no one watching.

structure.raw_value: BrWoDe.Two nights with no one watching.
structure.script_literal: "BrWoDe.Two nights with no one watching."

translation: Dwie noce bez nikogo na warcie.

source_text: Sorry, Father. But I can help out until we can get more help.

structure.raw_value: McSaEx.Sorry, Father. But I can help out until we can get more help.
structure.script_literal: "McSaEx.Sorry, Father. But I can help out until we can get more help."

translation: Przepraszam, ojcze. Mogę pomóc, dopóki nie znajdziemy kogoś jeszcze.

source_text: God Damn, I didn’t think that cop would ever leave.

structure.raw_value: NeAnOp^.God Damn, I didn’t think that cop would ever leave.
structure.script_literal: "NeAnOp^.God Damn, I didn’t think that cop would ever leave."

translation: Cholera jasna, myślałam, że ten gliniarz nigdy nie wyjdzie.

source_text: Nellie!?

structure.raw_value: BrShClNo1.Nellie!?
structure.script_literal: "BrShClNo1.Nellie!?"

translation: Nellie!?

source_text: I need your help, Brian.

structure.raw_value: NeAnEx^.I need your help, Brian.
structure.script_literal: "NeAnEx^.I need your help, Brian."

translation: Potrzebuję twojej pomocy, Brianie.

source_text: You owe me an explanation. What are you doing here?

structure.raw_value: BrAnDe.You owe me an explanation. What are you doing here?
structure.script_literal: "BrAnDe.You owe me an explanation. What are you doing here?"

translation: Winieneś mi wyjaśnienie. Co ty tu robisz?

source_text: I’m undercover, stupid!

structure.raw_value: NeAnEx^.I’m undercover, stupid!
structure.script_literal: "NeAnEx^.I’m undercover, stupid!"

translation: Jestem pod przykrywką, głupku!

source_text: You’re living under my church and running around the woods. Why are you tormenting me?

structure.raw_value: BrAnDe.You’re living under my church and running around the woods. Why are you tormenting me?
structure.script_literal: "BrAnDe.You’re living under my church and running around the woods. Why are you tormenting me?"

translation: Mieszkasz pod moim kościołem i włóczysz się po lesie. Czemu mnie dręczysz?

source_text: This isn’t about you!

structure.raw_value: NeMaAgNo1^.This isn’t about you!
structure.script_literal: "NeMaAgNo1^.This isn’t about you!"

translation: To nie ma z tobą nic wspólnego!

source_text: Calm down you two.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.Calm down you two.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.Calm down you two."

translation: Uspokójcie się, oboje.

source_text: There’s a monster harassing us and I think you might know how to stop it.

structure.raw_value: NeAnDe^.There’s a monster harassing us and I think you might know how to stop it.
structure.script_literal: "NeAnDe^.There’s a monster harassing us and I think you might know how to stop it."

translation: Dręczy nas potwór. Myślę, że możesz wiedzieć, jak go powstrzymać.

source_text: A monster?

structure.raw_value: BrWoOp.A monster?
structure.script_literal: "BrWoOp.A monster?"

translation: Potwór?

source_text: She’s talking about Madalyn Rose… The half demon.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.She’s talking about Madalyn Rose… The half demon.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.She’s talking about Madalyn Rose… The half demon."

translation: Mówi o Madalyn Rose… Półdemonie.

source_text: She appeared out of thin air and kidnapped me… and she made a hell of a mess in our hideout.

structure.raw_value: NeAnEx^.She appeared out of thin air and kidnapped me… and she made a hell of a mess in our hideout.
structure.script_literal: "NeAnEx^.She appeared out of thin air and kidnapped me… and she made a hell of a mess in our hideout."

translation: Pojawiła się znikąd i mnie porwała… a w naszej kryjówce narobiła niezłego bałaganu.

source_text: You expect me to believe you?

structure.raw_value: BrAnDe.You expect me to believe you?
structure.script_literal: "BrAnDe.You expect me to believe you?"

translation: Mam ci uwierzyć?

source_text: She’s telling the truth. I was there…

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.She’s telling the truth. I was there…
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.She’s telling the truth. I was there…"

translation: Mówi prawdę. Byłem tam…

source_text: Madalyn appeared and I used the holy water on her but after a few minutes she must have gained her powers back because she vanished.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.Madalyn appeared and I used the holy water on her but after a few minutes she must have gained her powers back because she vanished.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.Madalyn appeared and I used the holy water on her but after a few minutes she must have gained her powers back because she vanished."

translation: Madalyn się pojawiła. Użyłem na niej wody święconej, ale po kilku minutach musiała odzyskać moce, bo zniknęła.

source_text: She’s fucking up our shit. You have to help us stop her.

structure.raw_value: NeAnEx^.She’s fucking up our shit. You have to help us stop her.
structure.script_literal: "NeAnEx^.She’s fucking up our shit. You have to help us stop her."

translation: Rozwala nam wszystko. Musisz pomóc nam ją powstrzymać.

source_text: Watch your damn mouth, woman. You’re in a church.

structure.raw_value: BrAnDe.Watch your damn mouth, woman. You’re in a church.
structure.script_literal: "BrAnDe.Watch your damn mouth, woman. You’re in a church."

translation: Uważaj na język, kobieto. Jesteś w kościele.

source_text: You can’t turn me away this time, Brian. I need you.

structure.raw_value: NeAnEx^.You can’t turn me away this time, Brian. I need you.
structure.script_literal: "NeAnEx^.You can’t turn me away this time, Brian. I need you."

translation: Tym razem nie możesz mnie odprawić, Brianie. Potrzebuję cię.

source_text: I gave you a chance. You took a different road.

structure.raw_value: BrAnDe.I gave you a chance. You took a different road.
structure.script_literal: "BrAnDe.I gave you a chance. You took a different road."

translation: Dałem ci szansę. Wybrałaś inną drogę.

source_text: Enough about the past. Are you not a man of God? If she’s a demon, this is your problem as much as it is mine.

structure.raw_value: NeAnEx^.Enough about the past. Are you not a man of God? If she’s a demon, this is your problem as much as it is mine.
structure.script_literal: "NeAnEx^.Enough about the past. Are you not a man of God? If she’s a demon, this is your problem as much as it is mine."

translation: Dość o przeszłości. Czy nie jesteś człowiekiem Bożym? Jeśli to demon, to twój problem tak samo jak mój.

source_text: Can you perform an exorcism?

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.Can you perform an exorcism?
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.Can you perform an exorcism?"

translation: Potrafisz odprawić egzorcyzm?

source_text: If she’s demon possessed, I can cast it back to hell… But only if she’s human on the inside.

structure.raw_value: BrBaDe.If she’s demon possessed, I can cast it back to hell… But only if she’s human on the inside.
structure.script_literal: "BrBaDe.If she’s demon possessed, I can cast it back to hell… But only if she’s human on the inside."

translation: Jeśli jest opętana, mogę odesłać demona do piekła… Ale tylko jeśli w środku wciąż jest człowiekiem.

source_text: Have you heard of a shell being?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Have you heard of a shell being?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Have you heard of a shell being?"

translation: Słyszałeś o istocie-powłoce?

source_text: A shell being?

structure.raw_value: BrBaOp.A shell being?
structure.script_literal: "BrBaOp.A shell being?"

translation: Istocie-powłoce?

source_text: A… vessel specifically made for demon possession.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.A… vessel specifically made for demon possession.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.A… vessel specifically made for demon possession."

translation: To… naczynie stworzone specjalnie po to, by opętał je demon.

source_text: A soulless body?

structure.raw_value: BrBaOp.A soulless body?
structure.script_literal: "BrBaOp.A soulless body?"

translation: Ciało bez duszy?

source_text: That shouldn’t be possible. Where did you hear about that?

structure.raw_value: BrBaDe.That shouldn’t be possible. Where did you hear about that?
structure.script_literal: "BrBaDe.That shouldn’t be possible. Where did you hear about that?"

translation: To niemożliwe. Skąd o tym wiesz?

source_text: Someone who knows Madalyn closely.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Someone who knows Madalyn closely.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Someone who knows Madalyn closely."

translation: Od kogoś, kto dobrze zna Madalyn.

source_text: It might be important.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.It might be important.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.It might be important."

translation: To może być ważne.

source_text: Who told you about this?

structure.raw_value: BrBaDe.Who told you about this?
structure.script_literal: "BrBaDe.Who told you about this?"

translation: Kto ci o tym powiedział?

source_text: … Tasha.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.… Tasha.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.… Tasha."

translation: … Tasha.

source_text: She knows Madalyn personally?

structure.raw_value: BrWoCl.She knows Madalyn personally?
structure.script_literal: "BrWoCl.She knows Madalyn personally?"

translation: Zna Madalyn osobiście?

source_text: You should ask her yourself.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.You should ask her yourself.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.You should ask her yourself."

translation: Sam ją zapytaj.

source_text: This isn’t going anywhere. Can’t you use holy water and some stupid prayer?

structure.raw_value: NeAnEx^.This isn’t going anywhere. Can’t you use holy water and some stupid prayer?
structure.script_literal: "NeAnEx^.This isn’t going anywhere. Can’t you use holy water and some stupid prayer?"

translation: Do niczego nie dojdziemy. Nie możesz użyć wody święconej i jakiejś głupiej modlitwy?

source_text: Are you hiding something from me, Nellie?

structure.raw_value: BrAnDe.Are you hiding something from me, Nellie?
structure.script_literal: "BrAnDe.Are you hiding something from me, Nellie?"

translation: Coś przede mną ukrywasz, Nellie?

source_text: I don’t know what you’re talking about… It’s either kill the monster or give her what she wants.

structure.raw_value: NeAnDe^.I don’t know what you’re talking about… It’s either kill the monster or give her what she wants.
structure.script_literal: "NeAnDe^.I don’t know what you’re talking about… It’s either kill the monster or give her what she wants."

translation: Nie wiem, o czym mówisz… Mamy tylko dwa wyjścia: zabić potwora albo dać jej to, czego chce.

source_text: What does she want?

structure.raw_value: BrAnDe.What does she want?
structure.script_literal: "BrAnDe.What does she want?"

translation: Czego chce?

source_text: Some weird, old Egyptian artifacts.

structure.raw_value: NeAnEx^.Some weird, old Egyptian artifacts.
structure.script_literal: "NeAnEx^.Some weird, old Egyptian artifacts."

translation: Jakichś dziwnych, starożytnych egipskich artefaktów.

source_text: I wouldn't know anything about that.

structure.raw_value: BrBaOp.I wouldn't know anything about that.
structure.script_literal: "BrBaOp.I wouldn't know anything about that."

translation: Nic o tym nie wiem.

source_text: Do you think Father Zephaniah might have written about them?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Do you think Father Zephaniah might have written about them?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Do you think Father Zephaniah might have written about them?"

translation: Myślisz, że ojciec Zephaniah mógł o nich pisać?

source_text: Father who?

structure.raw_value: NeWoOp^.Father who?
structure.script_literal: "NeWoOp^.Father who?"

translation: Jaki ojciec?

source_text: Why would he be a part of this?

structure.raw_value: BrBaDe.Why would he be a part of this?
structure.script_literal: "BrBaDe.Why would he be a part of this?"

translation: Dlaczego miałby mieć z tym coś wspólnego?

source_text: I… I don’t know if I should say.

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.I… I don’t know if I should say.
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.I… I don’t know if I should say."

translation: Ja… Nie wiem, czy powinnam mówić.

source_text: 1Hero?

structure.raw_value: NeBaOp^.1Hero?
structure.script_literal: "NeBaOp^.1Hero?"

translation: 1Hero?

source_text: I found one of the Amulets.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.I found one of the Amulets.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.I found one of the Amulets."

translation: Znalazłem jeden z amuletów.

source_text: It was here, in the hidden basement.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.It was here, in the hidden basement.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.It was here, in the hidden basement."

translation: Był tutaj, w ukrytej piwnicy.

source_text: So you think it belonged to Zephaniah?

structure.raw_value: BrBaDe.So you think it belonged to Zephaniah?
structure.script_literal: "BrBaDe.So you think it belonged to Zephaniah?"

translation: Czyli myślisz, że należał do Zephaniaha?

source_text: So we only need to find one more.

structure.raw_value: NeFrEx^.So we only need to find one more.
structure.script_literal: "NeFrEx^.So we only need to find one more."

translation: Czyli musimy znaleźć jeszcze tylko jeden.

source_text: I’m not giving it to Madalyn. We don’t even know what it is?

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.I’m not giving it to Madalyn. We don’t even know what it is?
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.I’m not giving it to Madalyn. We don’t even know what it is?"

translation: Nie oddam go Madalyn. Przecież nawet nie wiemy, do czego służy.

source_text: I didn’t sign up for this. Dealing with a crazy gang leader is one thing, but a demon? I’m just about to call it quits.

structure.raw_value: NeAnEx^.I didn’t sign up for this. Dealing with a crazy gang leader is one thing, but a demon? I’m just about to call it quits.
structure.script_literal: "NeAnEx^.I didn’t sign up for this. Dealing with a crazy gang leader is one thing, but a demon? I’m just about to call it quits."

translation: Nie na to się pisałam. Z szaloną przywódczynią gangu jeszcze jakoś można sobie poradzić, ale z demonem? Mam już tego dość.

source_text: If you’re hanging out with gang leaders then I don’t want you hanging out around me.

structure.raw_value: BrAnDe.If you’re hanging out with gang leaders then I don’t want you hanging out around me.
structure.script_literal: "BrAnDe.If you’re hanging out with gang leaders then I don’t want you hanging out around me."

translation: Jeśli zadajesz się z przywódczyniami gangów, nie chcę, żebyś kręcił się koło mnie.

source_text: Trust her Father Solomon. She has her reasons.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Trust her Father Solomon. She has her reasons.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Trust her Father Solomon. She has her reasons."

translation: Zaufaj jej, ojcze Solomon. Ma swoje powody.

source_text: Can I see the Amulet?

structure.raw_value: BrBaDe.Can I see the Amulet?
structure.script_literal: "BrBaDe.Can I see the Amulet?"

translation: Mogę zobaczyć amulet?

source_text: Sure. Take a look.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Sure. Take a look.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Sure. Take a look."

translation: Jasne. Proszę.

source_text: That’s what Madalyn is looking for?

structure.raw_value: NeWoOp.That’s what Madalyn is looking for?
structure.script_literal: "NeWoOp.That’s what Madalyn is looking for?"

translation: Tego szuka Madalyn?

source_text: Doesn’t look very special to me.

structure.raw_value: BrBaDe.Doesn’t look very special to me.
structure.script_literal: "BrBaDe.Doesn’t look very special to me."

translation: Nie wygląda na nic szczególnego.

source_text: What do you think it’s for?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.What do you think it’s for?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.What do you think it’s for?"

translation: Jak myślisz, do czego służy?

source_text: If a demon wants it, it can’t be good.

structure.raw_value: BrWoEx.If a demon wants it, it can’t be good.
structure.script_literal: "BrWoEx.If a demon wants it, it can’t be good."

translation: Jeśli chce go demon, to na pewno nie wróży nic dobrego.

source_text: I’d give it to you, but if bad people are looking for it, I don’t think it would be wise to keep it at the church.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.I’d give it to you, but if bad people are looking for it, I don’t think it would be wise to keep it at the church.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.I’d give it to you, but if bad people are looking for it, I don’t think it would be wise to keep it at the church."

translation: Oddałbym ci go, ale skoro szukają go źli ludzie, trzymanie go w kościele nie byłoby rozsądne.

source_text: Keep it, 1Hero. I’ll look into this and see what I can figure out.

structure.raw_value: BrBaOp.Keep it, 1Hero. I’ll look into this and see what I can figure out.
structure.script_literal: "BrBaOp.Keep it, 1Hero. I’ll look into this and see what I can figure out."

translation: Zatrzymaj go, 1Hero. Zajmę się tą sprawą i zobaczę, czego się dowiem.

source_text: And Nellie… We need to talk.

structure.raw_value: BrAnOp.And Nellie… We need to talk.
structure.script_literal: "BrAnOp.And Nellie… We need to talk."

translation: A Nellie… Musimy porozmawiać.

source_text: What is it this time?

structure.raw_value: NeAnDe^.What is it this time?
structure.script_literal: "NeAnDe^.What is it this time?"

translation: Co tym razem?

source_text: I think you know exactly what I’m getting at.

structure.raw_value: BrAnOp.I think you know exactly what I’m getting at.
structure.script_literal: "BrAnOp.I think you know exactly what I’m getting at."

translation: Myślę, że doskonale wiesz, o co mi chodzi.

source_text: Christ in hell.

structure.raw_value: NeAnDe^.Christ in hell.
structure.script_literal: "NeAnDe^.Christ in hell."

translation: Chryste Panie.

source_text: Gad damn it, woman! No cussing in the church!

structure.raw_value: BrAnExNo1.Gad damn it, woman! No cussing in the church!
structure.script_literal: "BrAnExNo1.Gad damn it, woman! No cussing in the church!"

translation: Do diabła, kobieto! W kościele nie przeklinamy!

source_text: Oh, I’m sorry to interrupt. I didn’t know we had company.

structure.raw_value: JuWoCl.Oh, I’m sorry to interrupt. I didn’t know we had company.
structure.script_literal: "JuWoCl.Oh, I’m sorry to interrupt. I didn’t know we had company."

translation: Och, przepraszam, że przeszkadzam. Nie wiedziałam, że macie gości.

source_text: Come on Nellie. Let’s talk in my bedroom.

structure.raw_value: BrAnEx>.Come on Nellie. Let’s talk in my bedroom.
structure.script_literal: "BrAnEx>.Come on Nellie. Let’s talk in my bedroom."

translation: Chodź, Nellie. Porozmawiamy w mojej sypialni.

source_text: Ugh. Fine!

structure.raw_value: NeAnDeNo1.Ugh. Fine!
structure.script_literal: "NeAnDeNo1.Ugh. Fine!"

translation: Ech. Dobra!

source_text: What’s going on? Where is Officer Bobby?

structure.raw_value: JuWoCl.What’s going on? Where is Officer Bobby?
structure.script_literal: "JuWoCl.What’s going on? Where is Officer Bobby?"

translation: Co się dzieje? Gdzie jest funkcjonariusz Bobby?

source_text: He had to leave, but I’m here to make sure everything is okay.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.He had to leave, but I’m here to make sure everything is okay.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.He had to leave, but I’m here to make sure everything is okay."

translation: Musiał wyjść, ale zostałem, żeby dopilnować, czy wszystko w porządku.

source_text: Was that Nellie?

structure.raw_value: JuWoCl.Was that Nellie?
structure.script_literal: "JuWoCl.Was that Nellie?"

translation: To była Nellie?

source_text: We saw Madalyn… She attacked Nellie.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.We saw Madalyn… She attacked Nellie.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.We saw Madalyn… She attacked Nellie."

translation: Widzieliśmy Madalyn… Zaatakowała Nellie.

source_text: Madalyn is looking for two amulets… But we don’t know why.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Madalyn is looking for two amulets… But we don’t know why.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Madalyn is looking for two amulets… But we don’t know why."

translation: Madalyn szuka dwóch amuletów… Ale nie wiemy po co.

source_text: An amulet for protection?

structure.raw_value: JuWoCl.An amulet for protection?
structure.script_literal: "JuWoCl.An amulet for protection?"

translation: Amulet ochronny?

source_text: Is that a thing?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Is that a thing?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Is that a thing?"

translation: To w ogóle istnieje?

source_text: That’s what I always thought amulets were for… Protection from demons.

structure.raw_value: JuBaEx.That’s what I always thought amulets were for… Protection from demons.
structure.script_literal: "JuBaEx.That’s what I always thought amulets were for… Protection from demons."

translation: Myślałam, że amulety właśnie do tego służą… Chronią przed demonami.

source_text: I doubt Madalyn needs protection from demons.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.I doubt Madalyn needs protection from demons.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.I doubt Madalyn needs protection from demons."

translation: Wątpię, żeby Madalyn potrzebowała ochrony przed demonami.

source_text: Come to prepare for church tomorrow with Judy and I, 1Hero?

structure.raw_value: ChFrOp^.Come to prepare for church tomorrow with Judy and I, 1Hero?
structure.script_literal: "ChFrOp^.Come to prepare for church tomorrow with Judy and I, 1Hero?"

translation: Przyszedłeś z Judy i ze mną przygotować kościół na jutro, 1Hero?

source_text: Oh, no. I’m here because Officer Rinaldi left.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Oh, no. I’m here because Officer Rinaldi left.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Oh, no. I’m here because Officer Rinaldi left."

translation: Nie. Jestem tu, bo funkcjonariusz Rinaldi wyszedł.

source_text: Nellie came too… She’s talking to Father.

structure.raw_value: JuBaEx.Nellie came too… She’s talking to Father.
structure.script_literal: "JuBaEx.Nellie came too… She’s talking to Father."

translation: Nellie też przyszła… Rozmawia z ojcem.

source_text: So, we’re alone?

structure.raw_value: ChBaOp^.So, we’re alone?
structure.script_literal: "ChBaOp^.So, we’re alone?"

structure.script_literal: "TaBaOp.I’ll be in the library."

translation: Będę w bibliotece.

source_text: I should go there, too.

structure.raw_value: NeBaEx>.I should go there, too.
structure.script_literal: "NeBaEx>.I should go there, too."

translation: Też powinienem tam pójść.

source_text: I guess I’ll join them.

structure.raw_value: ElFrOp.I guess I’ll join them.
structure.script_literal: "ElFrOp.I guess I’ll join them."

translation: Chyba do nich dołączę.

source_text: I’ll be with the priest.

structure.raw_value: HrBaEx.I’ll be with the priest.
structure.script_literal: "HrBaEx.I’ll be with the priest."

translation: Pójdę do księdza.

source_text: Come on, Chloe.

structure.raw_value: HnBaEx^.Come on, Chloe.
structure.script_literal: "HnBaEx^.Come on, Chloe."

translation: Chodź, Chloe.

source_text: You know… I had an amulet, but I can’t seem to find it.

structure.raw_value: AdBaDe.You know… I had an amulet, but I can’t seem to find it.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaDe.You know… I had an amulet, but I can’t seem to find it."

translation: Wiesz… Miałam amulet, ale nie mogę go znaleźć.

source_text: Heh… I’m sure it’ll show up.

structure.raw_value: DiFlDe^.Heh… I’m sure it’ll show up.
structure.script_literal: "DiFlDe^.Heh… I’m sure it’ll show up."

translation: Heh… Na pewno się znajdzie.

source_text: Where are you going to go?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Where are you going to go?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Where are you going to go?"

translation: Dokąd pójdziesz?

source_text: I’ll figure it out.

structure.raw_value: AdBaEx.I’ll figure it out.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaEx.I’ll figure it out."

translation: Coś wymyślę.
